scenes.heading: Mental strategies and number tricks
scenes.sub: How do you do 47 × 99 in your head?
scenes.say: Can you work out forty-seven times ninety-nine in your head in five seconds? With the right trick, you can. In this video you will learn the smart paths through hard-looking calculations, and why each trick works.

scenes.heading: Think of it like this
scenes.everyday: Pay $19 with a $20 note and get $1 back
scenes.science: Round to a friendly number, then adjust
scenes.breaks: When you multiply, the fix is multiplied too: 20 × 6 is 6 too big, not 1.
scenes.say: Something costs nineteen dollars. You hand over a twenty dollar note and get one dollar back. That is compensating: use a friendly round number, then fix it. But careful. When you multiply, the fix is multiplied too. Twenty times six is six too big, not one.

scenes.heading: Round, then pay it back
scenes.question: Work out 47 × 99.
scenes.say: Ninety-nine is one hundred minus one. So forty-seven times one hundred is four thousand seven hundred. Now take away one whole group of forty-seven, not just one. The answer is four thousand six hundred and fifty-three.

scenes.heading: Quick multiplying tricks
points: Double one number, halve the other
scenes.say: Times five is times ten, then halve. Times twenty-five is times one hundred, then divide by four. You can double one number and halve the other without changing the answer. And look for pairs like four times twenty-five, which makes one hundred.

scenes.heading: Same distance from a round number
parts: the round number in the middle
scenes.say: Here is a Year 8 idea. If two numbers are the same distance either side of a round number, multiply them by squaring the middle and taking away the square of the gap.
scenes.caption: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

scenes.heading: Square minus square
scenes.question: Work out 43 × 37.
scenes.say: Forty-three and thirty-seven are both three away from forty. Forty squared is one thousand six hundred. Three squared is nine. Take nine away to get one thousand five hundred and ninety-one.

scenes.heading: Pairing a long sum
scenes.question: Add 1 + 2 + 3 + … + 20.
scenes.say: To add one to twenty, pair the first and last. One plus twenty is twenty-one, two plus nineteen is twenty-one, and so on. Twenty numbers make ten pairs, so the total is ten times twenty-one, which is two hundred and ten.

points: Round it, then pay it back
When multiplying, adjust by a whole group
scenes.say: Remember: round it, then pay it back, and when you multiply, pay back a whole group. Times twenty-five is times one hundred divided by four. And numbers balanced around a round number give square minus square. Now try the practice questions!
